answer: Fixed-pool dilution bond stops fake farms: each identity must anchor one claim to the pool and lock a 70-credit bond. A raven auditor checks claims on the public ledger; a rented-anchor ring fails: one key, two claims, both burn. Each new identity sends a ripple through the pool, shrinking every share to 40,000/N. 1,000 fakes pay 38 each plus 70,000 locked: 108,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 38 once and keeps the bond.
